cards.front: Procedure — eindterm 6.6.1
cards.back: Taking out an insurance policy and submitting a damage claim: compare and take out cover online or via an intermediary; report damage promptly with photos, receipts, and a police report in case of theft; then follow the insurer's claim procedure.

cards.front: Procedure — eindterm 5.2.2
cards.back: Making a public-transport journey independently: plan the route (9292 or the NS app), load or buy a valid ticket, check in and out on every leg, change between train, bus, tram and metro, and read departure boards and disruption notices.

cards.front: Procedure — eindterm 2.1.1
cards.back: Learning the norms of a new social context: observe what people around you do, and ask directly - Dutch directness makes asking acceptable rather than rude.

cards.front: Procedure — eindterm 4.4.2
cards.back: Claiming healthcare costs: providers usually bill the insurer directly; if you paid yourself, submit the nota via the insurer's app or portal within the period your policy sets.

cards.front: Procedure — eindterm 2.2.2
cards.back: Customs at birthdays, births, exam results, weddings and deaths. The eindterm names the occasions but not the customs, so there is nothing fixed to memorise.
